messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "doses above 0.61 mg/kg or greater than 40 mg"
set: ["doses above 0.61 mg/kg or greater than 40 mg", "above 2 mg/kg", "doses greater than 6 mg/kg body weight are not recommended", "greater than 95%", "experience with daily doses greater than 20 mg is very minimal", "40 mg", "above 1.4 mg/kg (or 100 mg) daily", "includes cisplatin doses of 50 mg/m2 or greater", "40 mg tablet", "total daily doses above 50 mg are not recommended", "doses above 400 mg a day have not been studied", "doses above 450 mg a day have not been studied", "doses above 1.4 mg/kg (or 100 mg) daily have not been studied in pediatric patients", "40 mg per day", "this recommendation includes cisplatin doses of 50 mg/m2 or greater", "40 mg once daily"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
